## Design

### 2026-10-18 – Journal: Marble Run in Onshape

**15h**

Journal: Marble Run in Onshape
Firstly it was the last day about 24 hours left before the deadline hits and yesterday I was new on Onshape and it was quite difficult to understand things in the start like I was so overwhelmed  because I didn't knew how to operate it but I got a hang of it and I finally completed my marble Run (by pulling an all nighter)

I followed the guide.
I created a new doc and sketched a square in the Top view. This is dimensioned to 100x100mm with 3 mm thickness, since i thought the  limit was 150x150x4 mm. Then I sketched a 50mm line, which serves as the track path through which the marble will pass.
Parts Construction: firstly I made the snake track using a line fillet method but it turned out that I wanted my snake track to be better and longer so I deleted that track and remade it using line + circle method there were many unconnected ends  after fighting with all of those it turn out to be that I had connected the snake track inverted so the U shape was facing downwards kinda hard to make changes in that as well then I moved to the funnel it was pretty easy and fun to make using the guide but then comes the staircase track (the one that killed most of my brain cells) thinking that I can do it easily and I will have enough time to do it (turns out to be a very very bad idea) sketching it was the easiest part the hardest part was adjusting it in my marble Run most of my time was gone in this and firstly I made a very long ladder so I trimmed it and redid it and extruded again (i did it 3 times thinking that the limit of the base is 150x150 but later got to know there is no limit🥲) the bigger problem was trying orient it in a way that the marble rolls down from the snake track into the staircase track also the bottom of the ladder kept sticking out of the funnel and the exit of the snake wasn't above the ladder's top end then the ladder was touching the funnel walls making it impossible for the ball to pass through it.
So I used Translate XYZ, Rotate. I determined the correct direction from the top view (left and right) and the front view (heightwise). Raising the ladder a few millimeters from its current position to make it stick over the funnel, with the same height added to snake to create a small gap of approximately one marble's diameter.
I also colored my parts using the Appearance feature.😋
Even now it wasnt the best but ive done whatever i could if i get a chance to edit it will make changes (i hope).
